>>298253676
So...if we had something like programmable nano technology, and we could produce any tool or piece of machinery, and this was available to anyone who wanted it, we would go a long way to collapsing the distinction between system technologies (refrigerators) and non system technologies (axes). If we could do that then we would have solved Ted’s problem, but if we can’t then Ted will s right and we probably need to revert back to about 1890s level technology (even that is pushing it) to preserve human liberty.
